# Code Anchors: Nexus Setup CLI

- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the single portable `nexus` entrypoint: verb dispatch (install, uninstall, migrate-components, deploy, seed-templates, workspace init/status/docs-root/add-repo/github-defaults), the stdin prompter, the read-only read-out paths over the resolver, and the deploy verb's own unsupported-arrangement notice.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/deploy-components.ts` — the one component mirror behind every component verb this CLI exposes.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/install-location.ts` — the account-scoped destination the install and removal verbs act on.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/migrate-components.ts` — the gated repository migration this CLI exposes for a repository still carrying a committed set.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workspace-init.ts` — the `workspace init` verb: sibling discovery, human hub/member designation, and writing the declaration; the component fan-out and its payload argument are gone, and the output names the account-scoped install and the migration verb instead.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workspace-init.spec.ts` — init discovery, designation, resolver parity, and that no component file is written into any repository.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workspace-add-repo.ts` — the `workspace add-repo` verb: appends one member to an existing workspace from a new sibling checkout.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/vendor-components.ts` — vendors the live component tree into the distributable and hashes the managed set for the fingerprint pin; defines the managed subtrees.
- `libs/workspace/src/write.ts` — the manifest/pointer writer: renders a candidate, validates it through the resolver's own parser, and writes only on acceptance.
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — the setup command: workspace-role detection through the resolver, and the account-scoped install named in place of a per-repository deploy.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/deploy-components.spec.ts` — mirror idempotency and user-file safety.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.spec.ts` — verb dispatch and IO behavior.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workspace-add-repo.spec.ts` — add-repo two-file mutation and collision rejection.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workspace-status.spec.ts` — portable status across hub, member, and single-repo.
- `libs/workspace/src/write.spec.ts` — writer validation-before-write and structured append.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/environment-guard.ts` — counts the component sets this CLI owns, by the same shared namespace predicate, and reports a duplicate this CLI resolves.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/seed-templates.ts` — the one repo-bound verb's implementation: it writes into a project's own configuration rather than the account's install location.
